scope: Unauthenticated bounded GET with default TLS; no forms/login/customer actions

link_graph.method: BFS from home using links among this bounded cached HTML corpus; query/utility/external URLs omitted
link_graph.limits: Query/context links were omitted; the two utility paths are not established orphan pages.

browser_smoke.method: Read-only unauthenticated real-browser smoke, normal TLS

HUB_ARTICLE_ROLE.severity: P2 semantic correction before index launch
HUB_ARTICLE_ROLE.basis: Primary purpose is resource/curriculum collection; the editorial-note shortcode alone currently infers Article
HUB_ARTICLE_ROLE.limit: Editorial interpretation of visible content and relevance guidance; no Google manual action or ranking loss observed

SITEMAP_404.reason: Current intentional closed-index configuration; WordPress disables native sitemaps when blog_public is false

EMAIL_PROTECTION_404.reason: Three real-browser widths decode to a mailto link; no-JS remains obfuscated; other public contact routes remain
EMAIL_PROTECTION_404.action: No Cloudflare setting or email sent

UTILITY_DESCRIPTIONS.reason: Public utility contexts have no description; noindex retained; no claim this causes ranking loss

SHOP_PAGINATION_DESCRIPTION.reason: Same catalog intent; self-canonicals are distinct; not treated as a mandatory uniqueness score

limits: Not a Googlebot/Bingbot/AI crawler identity check
Request duration is not a Core Web Vitals or target-market measurement
JSON parsing is not schema eligibility or truth validation
Intentional noindex/robots/sitemap behavior must be assessed against launch gates
68 HTTP200 documents are the bounded corpus, not a claim every possible site URL was audited
No Rich Results Test, URL Inspection, GSC, real bot/CDN identity or field CWV experiment performed
Raw HTML, headers, private journals and fingerprints remain outside public Git
